## Data Visualization with [`ggplot2`]( https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/) 

* The `ggplot2` package provides a set of functions that enable all sorts of data visualizations.
* We will cover `ggplot2` in more detail in future classes. 
* `ggplot2` is included in the `tidyverse` package, but to start using it you have to call it in a library function. 

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
```


## Remind yourself what the data looks like

Using our `unemp_df` data:  

```{r echo = TRUE}
library(ggplot2)
head(unemp_df)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
glimpse(unemp_df)
```
